integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic surreal body horror, photorealistic. <Subject 1> stands facing the camera in a tiled changing room at a public swimming pool, framed from the waist up, firm and naturally proportioned. The camera pushes in at slow speed. One side of the chest slowly sinks several centimetres, the surrounding body following like dense soft clay giving way to gravity. <Subject 1> reaches across and presses the softened area; each fingertip leaves a deep rounded dent that stays exactly where it was made. <Subject 1> places both hands on the sides of the torso and pushes the body back into shape; the waist narrows under the palms, and broad hand-shaped depressions remain. <Subject 1> releases it, and the torso holds its new sculpted form. The softness reaches the face: one cheek sags, <Subject 1> pushes it up with a palm, and the jawline changes with it and stays. Curious now, <Subject 1> slides the fingertips up toward the temple, nudges the nose slightly to one side and compresses the chin upward; every change remains, while the eyes stay alive inside the altered face. In the final moment <Subject 1> presses a thumb slowly into the centre of the forehead, and a deep perfect indentation remains.

overall_soundscape: Quiet room ambience, restrained breathing, dense soft pressure sounds, and muted material shifting under each touch.
